patterns.note: Asymmetrical section layouts, often pairing large text blocks with detailed UI mockups or illustrations, creating dynamic visual interest.
Extensive use of a light purple-to-blue gradient as a background element, especially in the hero and key call-to-action sections, providing a soft, modern aesthetic.

The primary navigation bar transforms from a transparent background with a subtle shadow to an opaque white with a distinct drop shadow as the user scrolls down, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport.
Feature sections frequently use a two-column layout where one column contains a large, detailed product UI screenshot or illustration, and the other contains concise descriptive text.
Headings are large and bold, often using a single line or short phrase, contrasted with smaller, lighter body text and occasional small, uppercase labels for hierarchy.

technique_notes: A sticky header navigation is implemented, which dynamically changes its background color to solid white and adds a subtle drop shadow upon scrolling past the initial hero section.
Content sections are designed to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing engagement as the user scrolls, likely utilizing css-keyframes.
Complex, multi-layered UI mockups are used as hero and feature illustrations, often with a soft gradient overlay or subtle depth effects to integrate them seamlessly into the page design.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) with a clean, modern sans-serif. Body text is highly legible, and small uppercase labels provide hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded. Buttons, input fields, and card elements consistently feature a moderate border-radius.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced. Generous vertical padding between major sections, with comfortable spacing around content blocks and within grids, creating an airy but structured feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of highly detailed, realistic product UI mockups and illustrations, often presented with a subtle gradient overlay or integrated into dynamic layouts, effectively communicates the software's capabilities and sophistication without relying on generic stock imagery. This visual approach makes the abstract concept of an HR platform tangible and appealing.
